verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any admin control for enabling or disabling Copilot agents per organization, group, or instance, and it shows no allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. The only Copilot policy item (github-docs-53) covers individual account settings. The 'Ask' vs 'Agent' chat-mode dropdown is a user-facing mode switch, not a governance policy. Fine-grained PAT permissions control API token scopes, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
